name: scenario_0068
description: Ashley is setting up a new creative workspace. She has a fixed starting budget and is using her device to calculate expenses, track her remaining funds, and split shared costs with her partner.

amazon.products.name: Apple Mac Studio M2 Max
amazon.products.description: Apple Mac Studio with M2 Max chip, 32GB RAM, 512GB SSD

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: I'm setting up my new workspace. Create a note called 'Studio Budget' and write down that my starting budget is $5000. Also, create a Splitwise group called 'Studio Expenses' so I can share costs later.
Instructions: Start the conversation by asking the assistant to create a note named 'Studio Budget' with a starting amount of $5000, and to create a Splitwise group named 'Studio Expenses'. If the assistant asks for confirmation before creating them, provide it. Once both the note and the group have been successfully created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: I need a main computer. Search Amazon for an 'Apple Mac Studio M2 Max'. Find the price, subtract it from the $5000 in my 'Studio Budget' note to calculate my new remaining budget, and update the note with this new balance. Then, add the Mac Studio to my Amazon cart.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to search Amazon for an Apple Mac Studio M2 Max, calculate your remaining budget by subtracting its price from the $5000 in your 'Studio Budget' note, update the note with the new balance, and add the computer to your cart. If the assistant asks which specific model configuration to choose, tell it to pick the base M2 Max version. Once the note is updated and the item is in your cart, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: I've uploaded pictures of three smaller items I want for the studio. Identify exactly what they are, find them on Amazon, and calculate their total combined cost. Subtract this total from the current remaining balance in my 'Studio Budget' note, update the note with the new amount, and add all three items to my Amazon cart.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to identify the three items in the images, find them on Amazon, sum up their prices, subtract that total from the remaining balance in your 'Studio Budget' note, update the note, and add all three items to your cart. If the assistant provides generic descriptions and fails to identify the specific toy car brand, the type of skateboard, or the notebook brand, point it back to the text and visual details in the images to get the exact models. Once the calculations are done, the note is updated, and the items are carted, move on to the next round.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Here are three more items for the studio. Identify them, find them on Amazon, and calculate their total combined price. Since I'm splitting these with my partner, divide the total by 2. Add Sarah to the 'Studio Expenses' Splitwise group and record this half-amount as an expense for her. Also, to save money, remove the Mac Studio from my Amazon cart.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the camera, printer, and light in the new images, find them on Amazon, and calculate their total cost. Then ask it to divide that total by 2, add Sarah to the 'Studio Expenses' Splitwise group, log that half-amount as an expense for her, and remove the Mac Studio from your Amazon cart. Because you have multiple contacts named Sarah, the assistant should ask for clarification. When it does, specify that you mean Sarah Chen. If it struggles to identify the exact camera model, guide it to read the text on the lens and body. Conclude the conversation once the Splitwise expense is recorded and the cart is updated.

  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4,5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
